title: At 12, he sold a space game he coded for about $500.
caption:
At 12, he sold a space game he coded for about $500.

Bullies pushed him down concrete steps. He was replaced as CEO during his honeymoon. His 10-week-old son died the week eBay bought PayPal.

His first three rockets failed. Tesla's funding closed on Christmas Eve 2008, in the last hour.

That kid is Elon Musk. Forbes puts his net worth at over $900 billion.

Which of these would have made you quit?
